messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: MSstats 3.3.2 is released
parts:
MSstats 3.3.2 is released on msstats.org

The main updates are
- Update all plots for ggplot2 v2.0. Now MSstats is dependent on ggplot2 v2.0
- Volcano plot in groupComparisonPlots will label protein name without overlapping each other and will not label protein name for proteins which are not significant (under 'sig' for adjusted p-value). 'ggrepel' package is used.
- For MBimpute=TRUE in dataProcess, the features which has only one measurement across MS runs will be removed for computation.
- Bugs, fillIncompleteRows=TRUE for label-based experiment, volcano plot with logbase=2, and so on, are fixed
- Change defaults for cutoffCensored in dataProcess. 'minFeature' is the default.
- Options for featureSubset in dataProcess are changed, 'all' (default), 'top3', and 'highQuality' for selecting informative features.

Please let me know if you have any difficulty and bugs.


- MSstats developers

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstats 3.3.2 is released
parts:
Dear MSstats users,

From v3.3.2, MSstats needs ggplot2 v2 or later, and new package, 'ggrepel'.
If you have old version of ggplot2 v1.x, please update it. Also, please install 'ggrepel' package. 

1) If you installed previous version of MSstats, please run the command below first,

install.packages(c('ggplot2', 'ggrepel'))

2) If it is the first time to install MSstats, please use the R script in msstats.org to install all required packages.

Hope to help.

- Meena
